# Agentic Coding with Claude

<p class="when">{{< var event.date >}}, {{< var event.time >}} · {{< var event.room >}}</p>

AI agents can read your files, run code and fix their own mistakes. The skill now is setting one up, steering it,
and checking its work. In 90 minutes you'll install Claude Code, hand it a messy spreadsheet, and watch it plan,
build and check a dashboard, including the moment it goes wrong and how you catch it.
:::

## What you'll leave with

::: {.finish-line}
<ul id="finish-line">
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="install"> Claude Code installed and signed in on your laptop</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="dash"> A working dashboard, built by Claude from a messy spreadsheet</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="catch"> Your plan checked against the boss's note, before any code was written</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="check"> The dashboard's key number checked against the official answer</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="memory"> A <code>CLAUDE.md</code> that remembers your rule, and a <code>/house-style</code> skill you can reuse</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="share"> A link to your dashboard you can share (Pro plan or higher), or a screenshot</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="own"> Something of your own, built in the last ten minutes</label></li>
</ul>
:::

<script>
(() => {
  const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('#finish-line input[type=checkbox]');
  let saved = {};
  try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('finish-line') || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
  boxes.forEach((box) => {
    box.checked = !!saved[box.dataset.k];
    box.addEventListener('change', () => {
      saved[box.dataset.k] = box.checked;
      try { localStorage.setItem('finish-line', JSON.stringify(saved)); } catch (e) {}
    });
  });
})();
</script>

## Before you come

1. **Check your plan.** Following along needs a Claude **Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise** plan, or a Console
   account. The free plan doesn't include Claude Code. No paid plan? Come anyway: you can watch, or pair up and be
   the one who checks the agent's work.
2. **Install Claude Code** with the [setup guide](setup.qmd). It takes about 10 minutes, and we'll do it together at
   the start too.
3. **Bring a laptop** (Mac or Windows) and its charger.

## Today's plan

| Time | What we'll do |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 2:00 | What makes an agent different from a chatbot |
| 2:08 | Install Claude Code together, open the starter folder, and set up a status line |
| 2:25 | The loop on a real task: **read**, **plan**, **act**, with memory and skills explained while it builds |
| 2:48 | **Check** it: one number you trust, and make Claude prove it |
| 2:57 | Make it stick: project memory and a skill of your own |
| 3:08 | Undo a bad change, and share your dashboard |
| 3:14 | Make it yours: build something you want |
| 3:23 | Habits for using agents responsibly |
